overview: A lead tied to a post, or shot on an arrow, to measure by, walk a circle round, rappel on and climb.

1.1.0: Lead arrows: a lead and an arrow crafted together. Where one sticks its lead runs back to you, held at the length it flew, to climb by sneaking. Click a fence to tie it off there; shoot a creature to put it on a lead.
A rope tied off at both ends, an arrow's lead at a fence or a lead from post to post, is climbed as a lead in hand is: sneak to take hold and climb, jump to drop a step, K to let go.
Villagers, wandering traders, zombie villagers and piglins can be put on a lead.
Hanging from a lead is steady: the lead's pull now reaches the player hanging on it, who no longer bobs.
Rappelling: each jump drops you a step down the rope, and holding sneak climbs back up.
With Block Tip 1.2, the reading stays up on its card instead of the action bar.
1.0.0: Tie a lead to a post and walk: it says how far out you are. Hold it at a length and walk a circle, or hang from it and climb.
